[spoiler][font=Trebuchet MS]
[size=3]1. Download the mod and its dependencies[/size]
[font=Trebuchet MS]2. Add the files to the \Mods folder
[size=3]3. [/size]Done!
[size=2]#. The mod can be installed or removed at any time during gameplay,
#. but it is recommended to use it in a new save.
#. If you have loose items or kegs placed around, use this mod to remove them:
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4715[/size][/font][/font][/spoiler]

[center]﻿[size=6][b]New Dynamic Maps[/b][/size]
[size=3]       [/size]
[quote][size=3]As the game progresses, rooms and houses will change depending on the heart levels of certain villagers and the arrival of others. And map message changes.[/size]
[spoiler][size=3]
- Heaps Convenience Store 2nd Floor -
After seeing Anton’s 4-heart event, his room changes into something more lively﻿

 - Alissa House -
After Alissa’s parents arrive, her previously messy room becomes organized and usable

- Mansion -
After seeing Ariah’s 8-heart event, her room reflects how she has become lighter and happier
The same happens with Louie: after his 8-heart event, his room changes slightly

- Shiro House -
After Yuuma arrives, her room is organized and small changes appear throughout the house[/size][/spoiler]
[/quote][/center]
[center]


﻿[size=6][b]New Map Interactions[/b][/size]

[quote][size=3]For better immersion, certain interactions were added to the maps. Some of them require unlocking access:

- Come have tea or juice at the Clinic. Paula now prepares, from time to time,
a small snack for patients who are waiting

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7NAi62Z.png[/img]﻿

- In the unused part of the hotel, some boxes are placed and removed every day.
How you get in there?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uQ5PdR5.png[/img]﻿

- In the Mansion pantries, there are various kitchen resources that are restocked periodically.
Obviously, you’ll need permission to take them. Only with consent

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ArfaWtL.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿

- Lost items scattered around the maps, waiting to be found...

[b][color=#e69138]Spoiler Alert![/color][/b]
Do not open if you don’t want to lose immersion[/size]

[spoiler][size=3]

- After helping Pika and receiving an invitation, on certain days he will allow you to use his kitchen
while he is cooking so you can taste his dishes.
Wait for him to cook, don’t rush the chef!

[url=https://i.imgur.com/YUalGxX.mp4]Video﻿[/url]﻿[/size][/spoiler]
[size=3]
Check the Articles to learn how to unlock the content[/size][/quote]
